policy.name: Revised Guidelines for 25% Capital Investment Subsidy Scheme to Micro and Small Entrepreneurial Units (Department of Industries, UT of Lakshadweep)

schemes.name: 25% Capital Investment Subsidy Scheme (CISS) for Micro & Small units
schemes.notes: 25% of total enterprise cost (land, machinery and construction), up to Rs 6.25 lakh. Only NEW units with P&M + building investment below Rs 25 lakh; expansion/modernisation not eligible. Second-hand machinery is excluded; only tax-paid (GST) bills count, limited to UTL approved rates. Units that got subsidy from LDCL, LKVIB, Coir/Coconut Board, NABARD etc. for the same purpose are excluded. Annual application calls; the latest found is File No. LD-19/3/2024-IND-TECH-UT-LKS for FY 2023-24 (deadline 12-02-2024). Guidelines PDF uploaded Aug 2019; the document itself is undated.

other_benefits: LANIDS 2018 (central; Lakshadweep and A&N): registration closed 31-03-2022, so expired for new units (30% P&M capital incentive up to Rs 5 crore, 3% working-capital interest, GST central-share reimbursement, transport incentive).

RAMP Strategic Investment Plan (2026) proposes capital-equipment subsidies for deep-sea fishing, coconut packaging and boat fabrication, plus transport subsidy. These are proposals, not notified schemes.
unverifiable: No UT industrial policy exists (UT declared a 'No industrial Area'); the CISS guideline is the only UT MSME incentive found.

CISS has no stated validity. Calls for FY 2024-25 / 2025-26 could not be confirmed (lakshadweep.gov.in pages intermittently reset connections). The scheme is treated as current because it is an annual standing scheme with no end date.
No interest subsidy, SGST refund, electricity duty or power tariff incentive found for Lakshadweep.
curation: lk-ciss-capital: scheme is only for units investing under Rs 25 lakh
